what: A vocal processor for the FM-1: a USB microphone goes in, and a corrected, harmonised, formant-shifted and effected voice comes out. The screen is an animated cross-section of a human head and throat that moves with the voice. Two engines: MULTIVOICE (the original plus up to three harmonised voices) and GLIDE (the detected pitch pulled to the nearest note of a key). Four reorderable effect slots, sixteen factory and sixteen user presets.
author: Laurens Profittlich
